scope: Clean external LP faces for ten newly identified/corrected albums plus mono Between the Buttons. Existing valid artwork on unchanged anchors is preserved. No served asset/canonical changes.

records.title: Sing It Again Rod
records.editionNote: 1973 UK Mercury 6499 484 die-cut LP, representative of the photographed Canadian Mercury SRM1-680. Both faces are the outer glass-shaped sleeve, not the removable inner sleeve or live-photo foldout.

front.editionNote: 1973 UK Mercury 6499 484 die-cut LP, representative of the photographed Canadian Mercury SRM1-680. Both faces are the outer glass-shaped sleeve, not the removable inner sleeve or live-photo foldout.
front.visualReview: Correct glass-shaped outer front with Rod portrait; no CD packaging. Square scan includes black surrounding the die cut.

back.editionNote: 1973 UK Mercury 6499 484 die-cut LP, representative of the photographed Canadian Mercury SRM1-680. Both faces are the outer glass-shaped sleeve, not the removable inner sleeve or live-photo foldout.
back.visualReview: Correct red glass-shaped outer rear with track lists; matches the physical rear design in IMG3589. Inner portrait/white concert panels rejected.

records.title: Caravanserai
records.editionNote: 1972 US Columbia KC31610 vinyl gatefold (Santa Maria), representative archive copy. Family printing is Canadian; matrix/plant identity is not inferred.

front.editionNote: 1972 US Columbia KC31610 vinyl gatefold (Santa Maria), representative archive copy. Family printing is Canadian; matrix/plant identity is not inferred.
front.visualReview: Blue desert/camel artwork with orange sun and Santana title, full LP outer front.

back.editionNote: 1972 US Columbia KC31610 vinyl gatefold (Santa Maria), representative archive copy. Family printing is Canadian; matrix/plant identity is not inferred.
back.visualReview: Outer rear blue desert/camel artwork and star emblem, matching the outer jacket design. The text/credits gatefold interior is not substituted.

records.title: Brief Replies
records.editionNote: 1970 Canadian Polydor 2425 022 LP gatefold, matching photographed label/catalogue/country at jacket level. Archive scans are a different worn copy, not the family copy; pressing/runouts unverified.

front.editionNote: 1970 Canadian Polydor 2425 022 LP gatefold, matching photographed label/catalogue/country at jacket level. Archive scans are a different worn copy, not the family copy; pressing/runouts unverified.
front.visualReview: Correct distorted group-photo outer front with yellow Ten Wheel Drive/Genya Ravan title.

back.editionNote: 1970 Canadian Polydor 2425 022 LP gatefold, matching photographed label/catalogue/country at jacket level. Archive scans are a different worn copy, not the family copy; pressing/runouts unverified.
back.visualReview: Correct black outer rear with title, small group photo, credits and distorted colour figure; 2425-022 on Polydor logo. The wide band/lyrics interior at image1 is rejected as a back.

records.title: Between the Buttons
records.editionNote: 1967 US London MONO LL3499 LP, matching the photographed mono catalogue and US programme. Family Canadian printing/pressing details are not certified by this US archive copy. Replaces the old stereo PS499 representative art.

front.editionNote: 1967 US London MONO LL3499 LP, matching the photographed mono catalogue and US programme. Family Canadian printing/pressing details are not certified by this US archive copy. Replaces the old stereo PS499 representative art.
front.visualReview: LP group photo explicitly marked LONDON MONO LL3499; no stereo PS499 lettering.

back.editionNote: 1967 US London MONO LL3499 LP, matching the photographed mono catalogue and US programme. Family Canadian printing/pressing details are not certified by this US archive copy. Replaces the old stereo PS499 representative art.
back.visualReview: Full Charlie Watts cartoon outer rear and twelve-track US programme, including Let’s Spend the Night Together and Ruby Tuesday. UK LK4852 programme is not substituted.

records.title: Magician’s Hat
records.editionNote: 1973 Canadian Charisma FC6062 LP, matching photographed plain-title cover layout and Canadian catalogue. Archive jacket has wear; actual family pressing/runouts not established.

front.editionNote: 1973 Canadian Charisma FC6062 LP, matching photographed plain-title cover layout and Canadian catalogue. Archive jacket has wear; actual family pressing/runouts not established.
front.visualReview: Plain cream title on black top band with fantasy landscape, matching family layout; UK/German decorative-lettering variants rejected in favour of this edition.

back.editionNote: 1973 Canadian Charisma FC6062 LP, matching photographed plain-title cover layout and Canadian catalogue. Archive jacket has wear; actual family pressing/runouts not established.
back.visualReview: Piano-in-forest outer rear, FC6062 upper right, eleven-song programme and WEA Canada credit below. Not a label or interior.

records.title: The Ecstasy of Rita Joe
records.editionNote: Museum of Canadian Music scans of a Jabula/Kerygma LP edition, not the photographed United Artists UA-LA126-F. Same front painting and purple bird outer-back design, different label/catalogue printing. Museum date1971 is not used to assert the family issue date.

front.editionNote: Museum of Canadian Music scans of a Jabula/Kerygma LP edition, not the photographed United Artists UA-LA126-F. Same front painting and purple bird outer-back design, different label/catalogue printing. Museum date1971 is not used to assert the family issue date.
front.visualReview: Flat LP painting/credits front, Jabula logo visible; family United Artists logo differs.

back.editionNote: Museum of Canadian Music scans of a Jabula/Kerygma LP edition, not the photographed United Artists UA-LA126-F. Same front painting and purple bird outer-back design, different label/catalogue printing. Museum date1971 is not used to assert the family issue date.
back.visualReview: Full purple bird/circular-credits outer rear; source explicitly names BACK. A small old catalogue/price sticker remains. Museum gatefold-inside scans rejected.

records.title: A Trick of the Tail
records.editionNote: 1976 US ATCO SD36-129 Presswell vinyl gatefold. Same catalogue/programme/design as Canadian photographed jacket; US copyright/printing is representative, not exact family pressing.

front.editionNote: 1976 US ATCO SD36-129 Presswell vinyl gatefold. Same catalogue/programme/design as Canadian photographed jacket; US copyright/printing is representative, not exact family pressing.
front.visualReview: Full cream illustrated character outer front and Genesis title.

back.editionNote: 1976 US ATCO SD36-129 Presswell vinyl gatefold. Same catalogue/programme/design as Canadian photographed jacket; US copyright/printing is representative, not exact family pressing.
back.visualReview: Cream outer rear with three character groups and small programme/credits below, matching IMG3615. Wide lyric gatefold at image1 rejected.

records.title: What Were Once Vices Are Now Habits
records.editionNote: 1974 Canadian Warner Bros W2750 LP, matching family Canadian jacket at album/design/country level. Archive copy only; matrix identity unverified.

front.editionNote: 1974 Canadian Warner Bros W2750 LP, matching family Canadian jacket at album/design/country level. Archive copy only; matrix identity unverified.
front.visualReview: Full black title band above live stage photographs, preserving the complete album title.

back.editionNote: 1974 Canadian Warner Bros W2750 LP, matching family Canadian jacket at album/design/country level. Archive copy only; matrix identity unverified.
back.visualReview: Correct live-photo outer rear with twelve-track programme; no CD tray or inner sleeve.

records.title: Okie
records.editionNote: 1974 US Shelter SR2107 LP, matching the photographed catalogue/programme. Family Canadian manufacturing is distinct; representative US archive copy.

front.editionNote: 1974 US Shelter SR2107 LP, matching the photographed catalogue/programme. Family Canadian manufacturing is distinct; representative US archive copy.
front.visualReview: Four-panel colour painting LP front with JJ Cale / Okie title, no CD banner.

back.editionNote: 1974 US Shelter SR2107 LP, matching the photographed catalogue/programme. Family Canadian manufacturing is distinct; representative US archive copy.
back.visualReview: Correct portrait outer rear with twelve-song programme and Shelter imprint; no label or inner sleeve.

records.title: Sun Secrets
records.editionNote: 1974 UK Capitol E-ST11359 vinyl LP, representative of photographed Capitol ST11359. Same original seven-part programme/design; UK E-prefix and printing differ.

front.editionNote: 1974 UK Capitol E-ST11359 vinyl LP, representative of photographed Capitol ST11359. Same original seven-part programme/design; UK E-prefix and printing differ.
front.visualReview: Four-musician cover titled The Eric Burdon Band Sun Secrets, matching photographed album.

back.editionNote: 1974 UK Capitol E-ST11359 vinyl LP, representative of photographed Capitol ST11359. Same original seven-part programme/design; UK E-prefix and printing differ.
back.visualReview: Cream cursive-title outer rear with Capitol logo and seven-part programme, matching physical rear; not Alchemy and not a later live cover.

records.title: Dire Straits
records.editionNote: 1978 Canadian Mercury SRM-1-1197 LP, matching photographed catalogue/country/outer artwork. Lacquer and pressing-plant details are not established for the family copy.

front.editionNote: 1978 Canadian Mercury SRM-1-1197 LP, matching photographed catalogue/country/outer artwork. Lacquer and pressing-plant details are not established for the family copy.
front.visualReview: Original grey/cream-framed blurred portrait front with Dire Straits title; Canadian Mercury variant.

back.editionNote: 1978 Canadian Mercury SRM-1-1197 LP, matching photographed catalogue/country/outer artwork. Lacquer and pressing-plant details are not established for the family copy.
back.visualReview: Four band portraits, nine-track programme, Canadian credits and Mercury logo on complete outer rear; no inner lyrics or label.
